annotations.title: Where to buy a Matter product

description: Names the stores MatterCatalog's product page links for one product (store links matched to the exact model, pack and region), with the product's certification answer and network, and links that page, where the store buttons, prices with their check times and the affiliate disclosure are. Store names only: no store URLs and no prices. Takes a brand and model, a MatterCatalog product ID or a mattercatalog.com/product/ URL.

product.description: Brand and model (e.g. 'Eve Energy Smart Plug'), a MatterCatalog product ID or a mattercatalog.com/product/<id> URL.
